label: boots
js: JSON.stringify({ screen: game.state().screen, title: document.title, scriptsWithSrc: document.querySelectorAll('script[src]').length })

label: real frames run the demo
js: new Promise(r => { const a = game.world().t; setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify({ ran: +(game.world().t - a).toFixed(2), phase: game.state().phase })), 1500); })

label: ? panel freezes the game
js: (() => { game.start({ level: 'easy', go: true }); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => { Kit.help.open(); const t0 = game.world().t; setTimeout(() => { const t1 = game.world().t; Kit.help.close(); setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify({ frozenFor: '1.2 s', stepsWhileOpen: Math.round((t1 - t0) * 120), runsAfter: game.world().t > t1 })), 600); }, 1200); }, 500)); })()

label: playCheck
js: (() => { const r = game.playCheck(); return JSON.stringify({ ok: r.ok, total: r.total, failed: r.failed }); })()

label: playCheck.prove
js: (() => { const r = game.playCheck.prove(); return JSON.stringify({ ok: r.ok, mirror: r.mirror.caught, stuck: r.stuck.caught }); })()

label: headless check
js: (() => { const r = game.check(); return JSON.stringify({ ok: r.ok, n: r.results.length, failed: r.failed }); })()

label: headless check can fail
js: (() => { const r = game.checkFail(); return JSON.stringify({ ok: r.ok, caught: r.caught.map((c) => c.sabotage + ':' + c.caught) }); })()
